title: Learner Variability and UDL
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting learner variability and udl to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Distinguish the firm learning goal from the (flexible) means of reaching and expressing it.
Apply the three UDL principles to remove construct-irrelevant barriers without changing the construct.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
